markets.rules_primary: If Harris Blitzer Sports & Entertainment and Comcast Spectacor complete the new 76ers/Flyers arena in the South Philadelphia Sports Complex before May 1, 2030, the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Completion Requires: official opening/first event, full occupancy permits, and a formal completion declaration by Harris Blitzer Sports & Entertainment and Comcast Spectacor.

Counts as Complete: minor deficiencies, cost overruns/delays, or minor scope changes — as long as the arena is fully open and operational.

Does NOT count as complete: groundbreaking, partial/test openings, one phase of a multi-phase project, conditional permits, funding-contingent status, or cancellation/abandonment/relocation.
